immutable_ref_policy: Candidates are recorded only at full Git commit IDs with tree and source identities where available. Moving refs and dated search responses are discovery evidence, never proof anchors.
credentials_policy: Anonymous public HTTP only; no GitHub code-search credential was available.
network_policy: Repository metadata and immutable raw/tree inspection only; no dependency clone, fetch, Lake update, Lake build, or .lake mutation.
search_order: manifest-pinned mathlib declarations and terminal source boundaries
official or primary Lean 4 formalization projects
other public Lean repositories at immutable revisions
historical Lean versions and other proof assistants as uncredited research evidence
aliases: factorial congruent to negative one modulo a prime
surfaces: owned and repository-local Lean files via ripgrep
all manifest-materialized package Lean sources via ripgrep
mathlib Git history and pinned source tree
GitHub code search with explicit authentication-failure handling
google-deepmind/formal-conjectures recursive Git tree at an immutable revision
negative_evidence_policy: Each bounded public query records a response hash or an explicit access failure. No internet-wide absence or discovery-saturation claim is permitted.
